target_role: Marketing or customer support manager using WhatsApp Business API
workflow: Submitting message templates for approval and waiting days for review, often requiring manual follow-up via support tickets or emails
trigger: Need to send new promotional or transactional messages that require template approval
current_workaround: Submit templates well in advance, reuse generic templates, or manually escalate to support for faster approval
consequence: Delayed marketing campaigns, missed time-sensitive notifications, frustrated customers

workflow: Manually reconciling monthly usage reports from the provider dashboard against invoices, identifying discrepancies in message counts, rates, or fees
current_workaround: Export CSV reports, compare in Excel, submit support tickets for corrections
consequence: Overbilling goes unnoticed, wasted hours on reconciliation, potential financial loss

workflow: Account suspension or phone number blocking due to quality rating drops, requiring manual appeal with documentation and waiting for review
trigger: Quality rating falls below threshold (often due to user complaints or opt-out rates)
current_workaround: Contact support, provide proof of opt-in, manually adjust messaging frequency and content
consequence: Business communication halted, loss of customer trust, revenue impact, urgent manual intervention needed

workflow: Building and maintaining custom integrations between WhatsApp API and existing CRM or helpdesk tools, handling webhooks, contact sync, and template management
trigger: Need to use WhatsApp alongside existing customer service platform
current_workaround: Use third-party middleware, build custom scripts, or manually copy data between systems
consequence: Fragile integrations, data inconsistency, extra development cost, delayed feature rollouts

workflow: When API downtime or critical issues occur, submitting support tickets and waiting hours or days for a response, then manually escalating through multiple channels
trigger: Production outage, template approval stuck, or billing error
current_workaround: Use community forums, contact account manager, or switch to backup provider
consequence: Extended downtime, lost revenue, customer complaints, team frustration
